subject: general
question:
Choose the past perfect tense form of the given sentence. 

"The programmer has developed a new software."

options.text: The programmer developed a new software
The programmer had developed a new software.
The programmer was developing a new software.
The programmer has been developing a new software.

solution:
Correct answer: The correct answer is **Option (b) - "The programmer had developed a new software."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The past perfect tense is formed by using "had" followed by the past participle of the main verb.
 
• In this case, "had developed" is the past perfect tense of "has developed."
 
• This tense is appropriate when indicating an action completed before another past action.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option (a) "The programmer developed a new software" is in simple past tense, not past perfect.
 
• Option (c) "The programmer was developing a new software" is in past continuous tense.
 
• Option (d) "The programmer has been developing a new software" is in present perfect continuous tense.
